shortDescription: User profile overview view for a developer account.
fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview view in its populated-default state by composing the shared profile overview screen component on the home route. The view shows the GitHub-style header, profile sidebar, overview tabs, repository cards, yearly contributions heatmap, and contribution activity section while keeping interactive controls immediately usable.

shortDescription: Shared profile overview screen component with interactive tabs and contribution year selection.
fullDescription: Provides the reusable user profile overview screen used by the home view. It accepts state and initialTab props, renders the profile header, sidebar details, repository card grid, contribution heatmap, and activity section, and manages immediate local interaction for the tab set, search field, and contribution year buttons.

Defines a standalone route for the dashboard-home view classification so the application exposes a dedicated implementation path for the dashboard screen. The current view presents a simple card-based placeholder for the populated-default dashboard state without affecting the user profile overview screen.
